properties.markdown: **How to read this dashboard.** The first section is aligned into three vertical stories: migration results, worker capacity, and target feedback. Read across a row to explain a rate change, then down a column for detail. The second section shows throughput and request shape; later sections are diagnosis and controller internals. Rates are fleet totals unless marked otherwise. CloudWatch fleet gauges are one-minute averages, so worker counts can be fractional during transitions. The controls are specified in RFS/docs/BULK_TRAFFIC_CONTROL.md.

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="throttled_429"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="admission_rejected"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: Target throttled

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="timeout"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="connection_reset"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="connect_failed"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: No response

metrics.expression: (SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="payload_413"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="other_4xx"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="5xx"', 'Sum', 60)) + SUM(SEARCH('{OpenSearchMigrations,OTelLib,attempt,outcome,qualifier} MetricName="bulkAttempts" OTelLib="documentMigration" outcome="other_status"', 'Sum', 60))) / 60
metrics.label: Other errors
